text: {"assertions":["A dropped frames bug was found in realtime/ws/session.ts that only occurred when records carried non-ASCII names.","The root cause was a listener that was registered but never removed, causing frames to be missing from the client sequence.","The bug could be reproduced by holding a socket open through a network flap.","The dropped frames bug caused cold start performance to degrade to 741 ms, a 20 percent drop.","The fix involved removing the listener on teardown and adding an assertion to test that it was properly removed.","PR #3134 was created on branch fix/dropped-frames-1 to address the dropped frames issue.","This dropped frames bug was located in the same area of realtime/ws/session.ts as earlier dropped frames work."]}
